entryPoint.doc:
Runs: `pwsh ./verify/intake.ps1 autonomous [-RunId <id>] [-Fresh] [-Provider <id>] [-Configuration <cfg>] [-MaxIterations <n>] [-TimeoutSeconds <n>] [-ImplementScript <path>] [-AllowPush] [-SkipCommit]
Status: `pwsh ./verify/intake.ps1 status [-RunId <id>]`
Archive gate: `pwsh ./verify/intake.ps1 archive-gate [-RunId <id>]`

futureAgentIntakeSteps: Inspect persisted run state and decide resume vs new run
Convert the request into an OpenSpec change (proposal/design/specs/tasks)
Diagnose failures and classify (Class A / Class B / external)
Repair (Class A auto-applied; Class B surfaced with root cause + diff for review)
Update evidence and task checkboxes with recorded verification
Push when an authenticated remote is available and operator opted in
Sync/archive and leave resumable state if interrupted

failureClasses.ClassB: product source - surfaced with root cause + diff for review, never auto-accepted
failureClasses.external: physical/legal/commercial/secret impossibility - recorded with machine evidence, never fabricated

resumeProtocol: On re-invocation without -Fresh, the latest incomplete run under verify/runs/autonomous/ is loaded and resumed at the first incomplete phase. Completed phases are never re-run. If the run is escalated or retries are exhausted, the orchestrator refuses to continue and reports deterministically.
